description: This source file defines the `ScreenRecordService` class responsible for capturing and recording the device screen, including optional audio, using ReplayKit. It manages capture sessions, handles video and audio sample buffers, writes media data to a file, and provides error handling and configuration options.

classes.name: ScreenRecordService
classes.description: Main service class for screen recording, managing the entire recording lifecycle, configuration, and error handling.

classes.name: UncheckedSendableBox
classes.description: A utility struct wrapping a value with unchecked sendability for concurrency control.

classes.name: CaptureState
classes.description: Internal class maintaining the current state of the capture session, including writer, inputs, and error states.

classes.name: ScreenRecordError
classes.description: Enum representing various errors that can occur during screen recording, with localized descriptions.

methods.name: record
methods.description: Public asynchronous method to start, manage, and stop the screen recording process, returning the file path of the saved video.

methods.name: makeRecordConfig
methods.description: Creates and configures the recording parameters such as duration, fps, output URL, and audio inclusion.

methods.name: makeOutputURL
methods.description: Generates the output URL based on user-specified path or temporary directory.

methods.name: startCapture
methods.description: Initiates the screen capture asynchronously, setting up the callback handlers for sample buffer processing.

methods.name: makeCaptureHandler
methods.description: Creates a handler closure to process incoming video and audio samples during capture.

methods.name: handleVideoSample
methods.description: Processes incoming video frames, handling frame skipping based on fps, and initializing the writer when needed.

methods.name: prepareWriter
methods.description: Configures the AVAssetWriter and its inputs upon receiving the first video sample.

methods.name: handleAudioSample
methods.description: Processes incoming audio samples, appending them if capturing audio is enabled.

methods.name: stopCapture
methods.description: Async method to stop the screen capture session.

methods.name: finalizeCapture
methods.description: Completes the capture by finalizing the writer and checking for errors.

methods.name: finishWriting
methods.description: Finalizes the writing process asynchronously and checks for success or failure.
